title: Healey Says Budget Will Protect UK Economic 'Resilience'
summary:
Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey discusses the International Monetary Fund's comments that the UK is the “country that basically stands out” for plotting a path to bring down borrowing. Speaking to Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz in Bangkok, Healey also discusses the importance of banks to the British economy, declining to comment on potential tax measures in the government's Oct. 28 budget.
(Corrects spelling of guest's name in headline.) (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Malaysian Central Bank Governor on Economic Growth
summary: Malaysia’s central bank governor Abdul Rasheed Ghaffour told Bloomberg's Avril Hong that the central bank has greater room to adjust interest rates after changing its policy guidance last month and stands ready to act if inflation pressures intensify as the Middle East conflict keeps energy prices elevated. Speaking at the sidelines of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank meetings in Bangkok, the governor said policy decisions will remain data-dependent, with the monetary policy committee assessing the latest information at each meeting. (Source: Bloomberg)
